Overview

This report uses empirical atlas presences from the raw occurrence matrix, not HMSC predictions. The saved model-input files are used only to define the survey rows and retained species for each coverage filter.

First, the analysis is shown for the Good/Fair coverage set, which matches the current model input. Then the same analysis is repeated for Good coverage only, so we can see whether stricter sampling coverage changes the spatial richness, delta richness, species-level turnover, and guild-level patterns.

Sampling-effort estimates are only available for Atlas 1 and Atlas 2. For Atlas 3, the visualisations therefore include all available Atlas 3 sites from the preprocessed atlas data rather than applying a Good or Fair effort filter. In the shared-site analyses, a site is retained only if it appears in all three atlas periods after applying the Atlas 1/2 coverage filter and the unfiltered Atlas 3 site set.

All richness maps count observed atlas presences for retained species. Delta maps and turnover summaries use only grid cells present in all three atlas periods within each coverage filter.

Species-level change classes are based on the change in the proportion of shared grid cells occupied by each species. A species is classified as Increase when the later atlas occupies at least 0.10 more of the shared grid-cell set than the earlier atlas, Decrease when it occupies at least 0.10 less, and Stable otherwise. In plain terms, this is a 10 percentage-point threshold in occupied shared grid cells.

Good/Fair Coverage

This section uses the Good/Fair retained survey rows and species pool from the current model input. Richness and turnover values are recalculated from the raw atlas occurrence matrix.

For Atlas 3, this section includes all available Atlas 3 sites because there is no Atlas 3 sampling-effort table to separate Good from Fair coverage.

Good Coverage Only

This section repeats the same empirical atlas analysis using only the Good coverage retained survey rows and species pool. This is the stricter coverage check against the Good/Fair patterns above.

As above, the Good coverage filter applies to Atlas 1 and Atlas 2 only. Atlas 3 includes all available Atlas 3 sites because sampling-effort estimates are not available for that period.
